title: Perform input validation on DAP requests
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in `master` c3058391d7bd1a13481c393061c164c24ec99685

### System information

Arch Linux

### Issue description

> [!NOTE]
> This comes from initial analysis on https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/115188

The DAP backend does not perform a lot of input validation when it comes to parsing external JSON requests. In particular, after converting JSON to `Dictionary`, we tend to assume some keys will exist and fetch them directly, as they're guaranteed by the spec.

With recent changes such as 0be2a77156b62fab044da64687d9d0b456f47bbe, this reveals we are trying to fetch a key that does not exist:

```cpp
ERROR: Bug: Dictionary::operator[] used when there was no value for the given key "checksums". Please report.
   at: operator[] (core/variant/dictionary.cpp:136)
```

Likely occurring at:
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/3f99bef808d32ebbbb5544e1f2e3d85d796bcd70/editor/debugger/debug_adapter/debug_adapter_types.h#L86-L96

While this doesn't seem to break debugging in any major way, it is a symptom of our lack of input validation.

LSP also found similar issues, and have been recently fixing them with a safer access to Dictionary keys ( #111684, #112128), so the same should be done here.

### Steps to reproduce

- Have a blank project with some code that hits a breakpoint:
```gdscript
func _ready() -> void:
    print("Here")  # <-- breakpoint
```
- Debug the project through an external editor
- Observe internal `Dictionary::operator[]` errors

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

N/A
